After a three-year hiatus, Wise Fruit NYC returns for its 12th edition with Ocean Ma, an interdisciplinary evening of dance, live music, collaboration, and community.

“Hosted by Courtney J. Cook and curated by Brinda Guha, Ocean Ma explores water as mother: forgiving and unforgiving, cleansing and dangerous, nourishing and accountable."

Centered on the feminine divine: not as gender, but as a force, Ocean Ma invites audiences to reflect on memory, stewardship, ancestry, transformation, and our responsibility to one another and to the natural world.

Throughout the evening, audiences will experience performances by acclaimed choreographers, live musicians, and interdisciplinary artists, alongside the beloved Wise Fruit Live Collaboration Series, where dancers and musicians create original work together in just one rehearsal before taking the stage.

This year’s guiding reflection is:

What we take disappears.

What we ignore persists.

What we love changes us.

As in previous editions, Wise Fruit serves as both a performance experience and fundraiser, with net proceeds benefiting a women-led organization advancing water stewardship and environmental justice. Headlining choreographers and performers to be announced soon.

Since their earliest incarnation in Yonkers, NY as Rigor Mortis in 1986, the members of **Immolation** have blazed an uncompromising path from the nascent tape-trading underground through their current standing as one of the most beloved bands in death metal history.

Propelled by the dissonant harmonic acrobatics of guitarist Robert Vigna and the subterranean growl and slashing rhythms of bassist/vocalist Ross Dolan, Immolation’s core duo not only led death metal landmarks like Dawn of Possession but piloted the band through music industry pitfalls of dubious record contacts, sketchy agents and the mid-’90s commercial collapse of the subgenre they helped perfect—and never abandoned.

**Ancient Death** is a Massachusetts-based cosmic death metal band formed in 2019. Known for blending progressive and technical metal with lush atmospheric themes, the quartet released their highly acclaimed debut full-length album, Ego Dissolution, on April 18th, 2025 via Profound Lore Records.

**Siege Column** is a New Jersey-based, old-school death/thrash metal duo formed by Shawnslaught Skullkrusher (guitars, vocals, bass) and Joe Aversario (guitars, vocals, drums). Known for their raw, lo-fi brutality, they blend early extreme thrash, d-beat, and blackened death metal.

Tabla is considered to be one of the most expressive melodic percussion instruments known to man.

Tabla is considered to be one of the most expressive melodic percussion instruments known to man. Its tonal qualities range from an array of subtle micro-tonal textures, melodic water-like resonance and pulsating walking bass lines.

This experience is geared towards the exploration of mnemonic syllables as a musical language, observation of movement by developing left/right brain independence, hand/finger touch sensitivity, relaxation by melodic and rhythmic entrainment.

Art of Tabla is located inside Surya Sound Temple, a space designed to produce, study and experience sound, music, art, yoga & meditation. Our mission is promote wellness and healing through music and sound vibration while preserving the teachings and practices of Shabd & Nāda Yoga.

This two-floor NYC party boat will be rocking with top DJ beats, flowing drinks, and unbeatable skyline views. Dance under the stars on the open-air rooftop deck or vibe out in the stylish indoor lounge. Whether you’re celebrating with friends or just living it up, this cruise delivers nonstop energy and unforgettable moments. Don’t miss your chance to be part of NYC’s most iconic boat party of the year!

What Does Your Ticket to the Haus on Hudson Cruise 2026 Boat Party Include?

🌊Iconic NYC Views – Cruise past the city’s most famous sights like the Statue of Liberty, Freedom Tower, Ellis Island, and Brooklyn Bridge with front-row views.

🌊Live DJs Across Two Levels – Move to the rhythm of Reggaeton, Hip-Hop, R&B, Afrobeats, Latin, House and more, spun by top DJs across two lively floors.

🌊Indoor & Outdoor Vibes – Choose between open-air decks for fresh breezes or a climate-controlled cabin with panoramic harbor views.

🌊Celebrate Life’s Big Moments – Ideal for birthdays, bachelorettes, anniversaries, or graduations. Feel free to bring balloons and cakes (note: outside food is not permitted). Check the ticket section for personalized event flyers.

🌊Onboard Food & Drinks for Purchase – Treat yourself to expertly crafted cocktails and delicious bites from our menu. We have a different menu each week ranging from amazing hearty meat options to vegetarian friendly eats.

🌊Professional Party Photos – Keep the memories alive with an event photographer capturing your best moments (details available in ticket add-ons).

🌊Convenient Access & Parking Options – Free street parking near the dock or nearby garage options (around $40). We recommend using Uber or Lyft for ease.

💃Dress Code:

We embrace individual style while keeping a chic vibe. Please follow the guidelines below to ensure smooth entry:

DON’T: wear anything with offensive text, athletic shorts, swim trunks, slides, sweatpants, Timberlands, sandals, or flip flops.

DO: opt for trendy and put-together looks. Jeans (with minimal rips), smart casual outfits for men (think collared shirts, stylish tees, and jeans), clean sneakers or dress shoes, and forward-facing hats that complement your outfit are welcome.

⏱️How long will the party last?

The event lasts approximately 3 hours as we sail through New York City's iconic harbor.

🗽Will I Get a Good View of the Statue of Liberty?

Yes! You’ll have a perfect photo opportunity with sweeping, 360-degree views of Lady Liberty and the NYC skyline right from the boat—so bring your camera and get ready to snap some unforgettable shots!

event.description:
***Arkose is making their NYC debut on October 23, 2026. They will have their ATL to NYC connection friends, Kevin Oliver Jr. & Freedom Attic on the show as well. There will also be some special guest.***

***Arkose: Arkose is the dynamic duo of Noah Sills & Tad Adams from Atlanta, Georgia. The multi-instrumentalists met in high school band back in 2012. They had a mutual love for Hip-hop, Jazz, R&B & Classic Rock.***

***The duo has worked with some great artists such as: Musiq Soulchild, 6LACK, Childish Major, Akeem Ali, SWAVAY, Chase Shakur , Jai'Len Josey, Lil Gnar, Eddie 9V, KELS & Kennedy Ryon.***

***They have also caught the attention of celebrities/artists such as: Snoop Dogg, DJ Jazzy Jeff, Raphael Saadiq, Giles Peterson, Ceelo Green, Joe, Sister Sledge, Stuart Zender, EARTHGANG, Trinidad James, and so many more.***

***The definition of Arkose is a sedimentary rock (A rock made up of rocks). That’s how they approach their music, hence their “Diamond Cut” sound.***

***Kevin Oliver: Born in Atlanta, Kevin Oliver, Jr, is a saxophonist currently pursuing an undergraduate degree at The Juilliard School. Kevin starting performing at the age of 11. He started off busking in downtown Atlanta at sporting events, parks and street corners eager to share his gift with the world. He was inspired to keep playing by the happiness that he saw on the faces of people who stopped to listen and meet him. Now 18, he has had the chance to take advantage of a plethora of musical opportunities. He was a part of the inaugural year of NYO Jazz directed by Sean Jones and played concerts at Carnegie Hall and across Europe alongside Dianne Reeves and a big band of some of the brightest young musicians around the country. He was also selected as a YoungArts Finalist for 2019.***

***Along with playing music, Kevin is also a stand-up comedian. From an early age, Kevin has been inspired by his heroes John Coltrane, Dave Chappelle, and Donald Glover. He was inspired by how each of these artists played music or told jokes in a way that was not only entertaining, but socially conscious. Kevin is inspired specifically by Donald Glover and wants to join him in dismantling the idea that performers can’t be great in multiple areas. He started his band the Kevin Oliver, Jr. Group in hopes to combine African-American musical traditions (gospel, early swing traditions, bebop, avant garde, hip hop, R&B) and stand-up comedy in a way that is fresh and uniquely his own. The sound was inspired by old playbills that had acts like Miles Davis and John Coltrane on a double bill with comedians like Richard Pryor.***

***His mission is to cultivate a sound and aesthetic that demonstrate a profound level of creativity, beauty, and meaning. By assimilating, writing, and performing, he aspires to create art that embodies his sincerest sentiments and to connect with his audiences in an honest way.***

***Freedom Attic: Freedom Attic is an artist that resides in NYC. From his wide range of Indie Rock to Indie Folk, Freedom Attic brings true meaning to the word Freedom in his music. The multi-instrumentalist demonstrates musical versatility that is refreshing in the indie scene.***

event.description:
Brooklyn-born and driven by soul, Janie May writes songs about what happens after you survive, when you choose yourself and don’t look back. Rooted in pop soul with influences from R&B, blues, alternative and country storytelling, her music explores resilience and empowerment. Janie’s music lives at the intersection of Gloria Gaynor’s unapologetic strength and Amy Winehouse’s emotional vulnerability. Drawing inspiration from artists like Fiona Apple, Lauryn Hill, Adele, and Kaleo, her sound feels both deeply personal and immediately relatable. Her sophomore album, Not Going Back, captures a pivotal emotional threshold: the moment you let go, move forward, and choose yourself. Janie’s music is for those who know what it’s like to take the leap, just as much as it is for those standing at the edge.

Dylan Taganas, from Long Island, NY, is a 23-year-old multi-instrumentalist who is currently experimenting with songwriting and making music. He aims to combine elements of genres like classical rock, modern and psychedelic pop, folk, jazz, progressive, and metal into a single centerpiece. The lyrics are personal, introspective thoughts, mainly scattered in the mind of a perfectionist. His work over the years will culminate in the release of his debut album in September. Taganas had been in various bands growing up and had opened for Filipino artists such as Aegis, Pops Fernandez, Sharon Cuneta, Arnel Pineda (the current frontman of Journey), and Bamboo.

event.description:
My name is Darren Keen. I am from Chicago and I do the one person band called PROBLEMS.

PROBLEMS has toured Europe, New Zealand, and America extensively. I have opened for Peaches, Sleaford Mods, Getdown Services, Dan Deacon, Pile, death's dynamic shroud, Mezerg, Lightning Bolt, Wolf Eyes, Plack Blague, and many others. I have played at Meow Wolf in Denver, and several fests including Camp A Low Hum (NZ), Laektro (DK), No Coast Fest (TX), UIUI Fest (Amsterdam) and the Petfest and Lincoln Calling fests in Nebraska.

12" LP "PROBLEMS GETTING HARD" Was released 4/10 on The Record Machine. Available on all streamers except spotify, because they fund AI weapons of war, this record was another leap forward in an already progressive catalog. Exploring the cycle of life and debt via a weightloss journey funded using buy now pay later schemes and musically anchored by the fender bass vi.

The 12” LP “Enter The Annals” was released 2024 on The Record Machine, and is now sold out. New LP "PROBLEMS GETTING HARD" will be released April 2026. I have previously worked with Orange Milk Records and Geertruida (NL).

I make composer driven electronic music with live vocals that is sometimes very fun and is sometimes very beautiful and is always interesting. I like singing about dogs, glue, and nuts. My new record is about getting jacked during the era of buy now pay later schemes and online banking.

His recent catalog includes the “Freak” EP with MEDUZA, the solo “Hyper” EP, and a remix of Linska’s “Bad Boy” that reached No. 1 on Beatport’s Melodic House & Techno chart. His records have drawn support from artists including Anyma and Solomun while connecting melodic tension, driving percussion, and heavy club grooves.

Behind the decks, GENESI has played Coachella’s Yuma Tent, ARC Music Festival, Seismic Dance Event, and Hï Ibiza, where he became a regular at MEDUZA and James Hype’s Our House residency. He has also supported Solomun during Milan Fashion Week and brought his sound to major clubs across Europe and North America.

On October 11, the extended format gives GENESI room to go deeper, build slowly, and stretch beyond the limits of a standard festival set. Expect a long-form club-ready session inside Knockdown Center, one of New York’s defining warehouse venues.

Buckle up for a stacked night of non-stop selectors and infamous party starters.

From 5PM–9PM, DJ duo Leg Room kicks things off in the Foyer with funky, feel-good grooves. Pull up early for happy hour from 5PM–7PM—entry is free before 10PM. Then stick around as Non Friction Records takes over both rooms with a lineup exploring every corner of electronic music.

Leading the night is Lubelski, a Los Angeles native whose sound is rooted in the wonkiness of the West Coast rave scene. Known for his analog obsession and eclectic approach to rhythm, Lubelski brings a decade of musical exploration into the booth– crafting sets that move between leftfield experimentation and deep grooves,.

Joining him is Matt FX, a born and raised New Yorker, producer, DJ, and true musical polymath. Moving effortlessly between house, disco, and open format, Matt brings an irreverent approach to the dance floor shaped by years immersed in NYC nightlife and creative culture.

Your Mom and Sylvan Paul go back-to-back, merging deep, hypnotic techno with dark, groovy house foundations. America Rose rounds out Cargo with her signature moody electronic lulls– balancing introspective vocals ethereal melodies into cinematic soundscapes.

In the Foyer, Tim Lucent blends the sex of jazz and the history of house with a deep love for sound itself, while Vibeiana moves between house, disco, electronic, and techno with a singular musicality rooted in the New York house tradition.

H0L0 Yard welcomes Sorley and Braydon Terzo on Saturday, August 29th for a night centered around underground house music, deep grooves, and late-night club energy. Joining them is local talent baby-g and Jayside.

Sorley has become one of the standout names connected to the new wave of UK house music, earning recognition through releases on Solid Grooves, Cuttin’ Headz, Revival, Disorder, and his own imprint SOUL93. Known for bass-heavy productions, raw groove, and vocal-driven club records, he has brought his sound to major venues including Hï Ibiza, Amnesia, and Savaya while continuing to build momentum across the global underground scene.

Joining him is California producer Braydon Terzo, whose blend of minimal tech house and indie dance influences has quickly placed him on the radar of dancefloors worldwide. His stripped-back grooves and bassline-focused productions have earned support from Chris Lake, Cloonee, Chris Stussy, Jamie Jones, Mau P, and Sosa, while releases on his label Roots Recordings have climbed to the top of Beatport’s Minimal / Deep Tech charts.

Together, the pair bring a forward-thinking sound rooted in underground club culture, making this one of the standout late-summer sessions at H0L0 Yard. Expect deep selections, high-energy sets, and a packed dancefloor from start to finish

event.description:
"Slow is fast," says Mike Scheidt, singer, guitarist, and creative nucleus of the Oregon-based doom metal trio **YOB**. It's a concept that speaks to both the immense propulsion of their megalithic compositions and the way their artistry has patiently unfurled across their 25-year tenure. Change and revelation take time. You can't snap yourself into epiphany and you can't force yourself into another shape. You have to trudge. It doesn't mean you're failing. You persevere through the muck or you stop and you sink. There is no third way.

YOB's music spreads across a plain where vast weather systems converge. Since sharing their first demo in 2000, the band has slowly, graciously gathered a devoted audience into their planetary orbit. Together with bassist Aaron Rieseberg and drummer Dave French, Scheidt tethers pendulous riffs to sky-flung vocals, sinking deep into the trenches and then cresting through the clouds. From the stoner rock ripples of their 2002 debut Elaborations of Carbon through the cavernous echoes of 2018's Our Raw Heart, YOB wield their totalizing gravity to bore into the light that hides in everything.

event.description:
Nitefreak brings HiNDE, his event series and global movement, to Brooklyn for a rare New York appearance at 99 Scott. Joining him is TOMER and Samantha Michelle.

Rooted in Zimbabwe and built from the ground up, HiNDE has grown from a local platform in Bulawayo into an international presence, with showcases across Harare, Miami Music Week, Mauritius, and the United States. The project reflects a focus on Afro house and Afro Tech, connecting artists, communities, and audiences through a shared sound.

At the center of it is Nitefreak, who began producing in 2009 and has steadily developed a global following. His releases on Deep Root Records, Spinnin Deep, Higher Ground, and Insomniac have earned support from Black Coffee, Diplo, Shimza, and Keinemusik, while his catalog has reached millions of streams and multiple Beatport chart placements. Tracks like Savior, Gorah, and Kamili have become staples across clubs and radio, with plays on BBC Radio 1 and beyond. His record Bolingo Nanga also reached a wider audience through its inclusion in the Francis Ngannou documentary.

This night centers on HiNDE’s vision, bringing its sound into one of Brooklyn’s leading warehouse spaces. Expect an extended set from Nitefreak alongside a deeper look into the movement he continues to build across continents.

event.description:
Originally starting life as a trio, North London outfit **Ivy Lab** were brought together out of a shared enthusiasm for experimentations on the fringes of the UK bass music scene. The years that followed saw them go from strength to strength, earning a place in ‘The top 10 DJ’s of 2015’ (Mixmag) and propagating a new generation of hip-hop inspired abstractions housed within the framework of their ’20/20 LDN’ project.

The duo now find themselves at the apex of the ‘Halftime’ / ‘Future Beats’ / movement – A motley assortment of actors from across the bass music landscape applying their sonic-heritage to experiments with hip-hop and drum machine electronica.

Ivy Lab invested further in the exploration of this sound with the creation of their ‘20/20 LDN’ clubnight. Housed primarily at Brixton’s Phonox nightclub, it earned the characterisation of “ultra innovative” (Timeout Magazine) and a “London standout” (Mixmag).

Minted in late 2015, and borrowing the same raison d’être as its elder sibling nightlife brand; 20/20 LDN Recordings was unveiled with the pseudo-mixtape/compilation LP “Ivy Lab presents 20/20 Volume.1” – described as “uncompromising, insightful and rather awesome : 9/10” (Mixmag) and “impossible to categorise : 9/10” (DJ Mag) . Little over a year (and only 5 releases deep) the label was awarded the title of ’Best Breakthrough Label 2016’ in the DJ Mag ‘Best of British Awards 2016’.

Now a galvanising presence in the ‘Future Beats’ movement, Ivy Lab’s’ “20/20 Volume.1” release and the subsequent follow up E.P’s were benchmark moments in forging the genre into a pillar of the electronic music landscape. Tracks such as “Spooky Dub”, “Can’t Say No” & “Peninsula” all garnered incredible currency, supplemented by showpiece remixes for Banks (“Fuck with myself”) and Noisia (“Tentacles”).

That same currency as bass music figureheads has been embraced by festivals as varied as Glastonbury, EDC Vegas, SXSW, Sonar (Barcleona + HK), CTM Berlin, Dour, ADE, Woo Hah!, Shambhala, Lightning In A Bottle, Lowlands, Origin NYE, Exit & Outlook.

Ivy Lab head into the horizon not only with an anchored presence at the cutting edge of the bass-music landscape, but also a secured reputation as pioneering label bosses & event promoters in ownership of one of the UK’s most exciting contemporary music brands.

event.description:
The Sleeves are the duo of Jack Cooper and Tara Cunningham, both likely known to you as one half of Modern Nature. Following an all-instrumental Mossy Tapes release last November, Cooper and Cunningham have recorded 10 new songs showcasing their vocal and guitar interplay with only the faintest echoes of prior efforts (individually or collectively), representing a fully realized leap forward from their largely improvised debut.

'The Sleeves' is a somewhat counter intuitive take on the guitar/vocal duo formula (provided you think there is such a thing) though it's not nearly as simplistic as "the space between the notes" -- it would be the height of exaggeration to say an album this simultaneously expansive and incandescent is unprecedented. But it doesn't happen nearly often enough, either. The Sleeves have London and NYC dates planned for this July and September respectively, with further touring to be announced in the coming weeks.

“What I initially found so familiar and exciting about playing guitar with Jack - and continually do - is that our approach to music is pretty much exactly the same. And that is - to celebrate the space that frames ideas, embraces silence, to play simply, simultaneously championing our respective unembellished guitar sounds, whilst looking for sounds that aren’t like a guitar at all - bells, birds, switching between radio stations etc. It’s rare to find someone who - whatever this means to you - ‘gets it’ - and I think when we started playing guitar together, we both knew the other had something of whatever our ‘it’ was.”

“‘The Sleeves’ is the sum of our shared musical journey thus far, an exciting mix of familiarity and uncharted territory in its approach to structure and how we use our guitars and voices. It feels to me like we are both citing shared references and traditions, whilst floating in our own, single-cell world that is completely genre-less. That grey area is where we seem to thrive. As Jack says, it feels like music that really couldn’t be made by anyone else.” - Tara Cunningham

“Tara and I started playing guitar together at the start of 2024. It was an improvised music night in a railway arch in South London. The set was great but there was a couple of minutes in particular where Tara and I really sort of locked in. We made a record a few weeks later. There was something in the way we played together that felt very intuitive from the start. We recognised a shared approach right away and an affinity to the way each other played.”

“During the summer we got stuck in a traffic jam coming home from a show in Glasgow. We spent a few hours singing along to the Mamas & The Papas and Simon & Garfunkel and over the course of the day, like magic we became The Sleeves."

“We're excited about it because it feels like music that really couldn’t be made by anyone else. We don’t bring different elements to it. We both bring exactly the same things. It’s the result of our similarities.” - Jack Cooper

event.description:
Sunday Skate Club ft. David Paglia, Club Flush: ANICHE (skate all night)

A love letter to Sunday Skate Club 🫶

Every Sunday from 8–12am, the rink becomes more than a skate session. It’s a weekly ritual where local club kids, industry folks, and NYC’s DJs get their flowers — and skate heads and music heads move in the same orbit.

Here you see the true versatility of a DJ. That epic artist you loved at 5am now accepts the challenge of an all-skate set around a groovy 100bpm — R&B, disco, and other unexpected jams. It’s a rare chance to hear their non-unz unz selections like R&B, disco, you name it. From thudding foggy sweaty beats the morning before (well, it may have still been your ‘night’) to idyllic skating in a psychedelic rink with jams that make you smile big. You start with a few laps, feeling out the floor, the room fills, the rhythm builds, and before long, you’re moving without thinking — just you, the music, and the night.

Then you notice friends slipping into the bathrooms… only it’s Club Flush, pulling the off-wheels crowd into something sweatier, louder, a little unhinged. Red-lit and hazy, fog stretching the room so it feels bigger than it is. An 18” sub shakes the floor, a hidden 21” built straight into the booth hits your chest. There are no grimy stalls, no smells (thanks all!) just a fully enclosed, immersive room. A few minutes in, and you forget you’re even standing in a bathroom. You might walk in for a second and stay for half a set. You might discover your new favorite DJ. You might skate, then dance, then skate again. That’s the point.

Every week is a different crew, a different sound, a different pocket of the city’s underground stepping forward. Sunday Skate Club is about unified movement — wheels, feet, bass, community. When these scenes overlap, the energy multiplies, and the night becomes something bigger than the sum of its parts.

See you every Sunday at 8.

event.description:
**Austin Sley Julian**

Using prepared guitar, handmade instruments, discarded artifacts and found debris, Austin Sley Julian creates kinetic, physically jagged sound structures that propel at their audiences. Evoking feelings of anguish, frustration, and inherent conflict, confronting the ugly/beautiful instability of our moment and condition.

•

**John Blum + Ryan Sawyer**

**John Blum** is one of New York's most distinctive voices in creative improvised music. A pianist and composer with more than three decades of international performance experience, Blum has developed a fiercely individual style that draws from the legacies of Cecil Taylor, McCoy Tyner, bebop, stride piano, and the free jazz tradition while remaining unmistakably his own. A longtime fixture of New York City's downtown music scene, he has performed and recorded with luminaries including Sunny Murray, Marshall Allen, Han Bennink, David Murray, Peter Brötzman, Dave Liebman, and many others. His performances are celebrated for their explosive energy, technical brilliance, and emotional depth, earning him recognition as one of the most compelling improvising pianists of his generation.

**Ryan Sawyer** is an acclaimed drummer, percussionist, and composer whose adventurous musical voice bridges the worlds of free improvisation, jazz, rock, and experimental music. Originally from San Antonio, Texas, Sawyer has been an integral part of New York's creative music community since the late 1990s. His wide-ranging collaborations include performances with Marshall Allen, Charles Gayle, Thurston Moore, Gang Gang Dance, TV on the Radio, Rhys Chatham, and Nate Wooley, among many others. Renowned for his remarkable command of texture, dynamics, and rhythmic invention, Sawyer brings an unmistakable blend of sensitivity, power, and spontaneity to every performance, making him one of today's most versatile and sought-after improvising drummers.

•

**Dan Gitlin + Rose Tang Duo**

**Dan Gitlin** (he/him/they) is a Brooklyn-based Chapman Stickist, guitarist, and general noise making guy.

**Rose Tang** is a multi-disciplinary artivist. Her current main toys are piano, electric guitar, voice and words. She's the founder/host of Fuck Fascism Festival.

event.description:
Darkwave synth pop got its swagger back in the enigmatic single and debut music video, Dead/Basic by the alt-indie trio, Bushwick Princess, who may not hide their influences, in this case, it’s a mash-up of Thriller-era Michael Jackson and Depeche Mode, but originality still slithers from the single, which gyrates through the shadows of 80s pop and the strobe lights of electronic post-punk.

Ticket Price: $15 in advance, $20 at door

As an earworm guaranteed to give you hard enough kinetic kicks you’ll be left with bruises, Bushwick Princess, with their deadpan debonair panache, left nothing to be desired. There’s no trace of irony in the mantra “I’d rather be dead than basic”, which could be read as pretentious, but those in the know will resonate with the refrain that highlights the insufferable nature of a world which rejects culture and individuality for hegemony.

It’s the kind of single you could imagine Joe Keery releasing, if he were daring enough to be contrarian in a bid to comfort the other disturbed outliers looking for anthems to dance to on the edge of acceptability; the cinematic music video is effortlessly in that vein. Just don’t ask where they got that coffin.

Based in Brooklyn and led by Matt Francini, Bushwick Princess is setting Dead/Basic up as the opening statement from an EP due later this year, channelling a love for indie dance and post-punk through a sound that also tips its hat to LCD Soundsystem and Hot Chip. If you’re tired of banal and superficial alt-electronica, you’ll want to save a space on your radar for the forthcoming hits from Bushwick Princess, who have more than earned their royal status with their debauched approach to adding a touch of class to the airwaves.

From 10 PM to 4 AM, the UK-born DJ and producer takes control of the room for six uninterrupted hours of his signature blend of house, UK garage, and rolling low-end grooves.

event.description: Joris Voorn sits at the epicenter of the Dutch electronic music scene, the most renowned and instantly recognisable artist from Holland, representing underground house and techno on a wider global stage. For a country with a population of just seventeen million Holland’s contribution to world electronic music is unsurpassed. While house and techno trace their roots to the marginal and mainly black American underground, its taken a relatively small country in the European lowlands to flip electronic music on its head and turn it into the global powerhouse it is today. In 2016 few could deny that Amsterdam is the global capital of electronic music and few artists embody the melting pot of musical influences that define the city’s underground techno scene more than Joris Voorn.Joris is the embodiment of the modern-art and tech-savvy touring DJ, with both feet planted in firmly in the underground techno world, but a keen eye for contemporary art, photography and a long-standing love of architecture (you only need to check his Instagram or EP covers to see where this all comes together). Born in the Dutch town of Tilburg, the son of a composer and a music teacher, Joris gained international recognition with his breakout ‘Muted Trax EP’ on Keynote which was followed quickly by his universally acclaimed ‘Lost Memories EP’ on Sino the following year. Its follow-up ‘Lost Memories Part 2’ in 2004 included the standout track ‘Incident’ which became an immediate and firm fixture in the sets of many of his now-peers including Carl Cox, Derrick May and Laurent Garnier and was one of the standout tunes of that summer at clubs everywhere from The Sub Club to Circo Loco. Since then he has gone on to release three hugely critically acclaimed artist albums, ‘Future History’ (released on on Sino in 2004), ‘From A Deep Place’ (released on Green in 2007) and the most recent ‘Nobody Knows’ voted electronic album of the year 2014 by Billboard Magazine in the US. He has backed these up with dearly loved mix compilations for Belgian techno bastion Fuse, Australia’s Balance series and most recently London underground superclub fabric.In 2005 he founded the founded ‘Green’ the first of two labels which he runs with long-time collaborator Edwin Oosterwal. This has provided a platform for Joris’ two most recent albums, plus some of his biggest hits including 2013’s ‘Ringo’ and his 2016’s ‘Looks Fake Obviously’. The second label ‘Rejected’ has given him an outlet for more straight-up house tracks aimed squarely at the dancefloor such his various installments in the ‘Dusty House’ series of Eps plus somewhere to release tracks from his peers such as Deetron, Anton Pieete, Ian Pooley and Steve Rachmad. These two labels represent the opposing ends of the ‘Spectrum’ of underground music that Joris is proud to champion. In fact, this word is so synonymous with the wide range of underground musical styles that inspire and inform both Joris’ DJing and production work that he decided to call his forthcoming radio show and event series ‘Spectrum’, allowing him to fully explore the full reach of his extensive musical tastes and share them with a wider audience.Throughout the years Ibiza has always played an active part in Joris’ summer touring diary, from early gigs at We Love on Sundays at Space, through to his more recent La Familia nights at Ushuaia with Nic Fancuilli, in 2016 Joris has in the enviable position of holding not one but two key residencies in Ibiza, at ANTS at Ushaia alongside the likes of Maya Janes Coles and Kolsch, and El Row at Space alongside Eats Everything, Paco Osuna and Groove Armada.Outside of Ibiza, Joris is a regular fixture at all of the key clubs and festivals on the global underground circuit performing multiple weekly shows at events across Europe, Japan, Hong Kong, China, Singapore, Australia, Russia, Brazil, Colombia, Israel, Detroit, Chicago and New York. These include clubbing institutions such as fabric (London), Output (New York), Womb (Tokyo), Fuse (Brussels), Faust (Paris), Warehouse Project (Mancheser), elrow (Barcelona) fabrik (Madrid), Zouk (Singapore) and Spazio 900 (Rome). As far as festivals are concerned Joris has a long-running relationship with both the Awakenings and Strafwerk/Digital events series in his native Holland while further afield he can be found playing at festivals such as Parklife (Manchester), Movement (Detroit) Tobacco Dock (London), Ultra (Miami), Mysterylands (Amsterdam), Hideout (Croatia), Electric Zoo (New York) and BPM (Mexico).

event.description:
**Emma Ruth Rundle** made a conscious choice to reach towards making a hopeful record for the follow up to 2021’s *Engine of Hell*. Where outside forces tempted her to turn inwards, towards isolation and hopelessness, she instead reached outwards to create a record that acknowledges pain, but offers both community and resilience in response. Although *These Killing Times* possesses a spirit of defiance, it retains the tenderness and vulnerability that saw her earlier work resonate with so many listeners.

*These Killing Times* is electrifying, emotional, and charged with feminine rage; it is a reactive anthology, bristling, full of life and full of resistance - forged by and for community. It asks many questions - of the roles we play as individuals, or as artists - and closes with this one: what will we live for beyond the valley of the shadow of the fear of all men? A question with no definitive answer as yet, but one that is being asked with increasing urgency - here on this record, and beyond.

**Cinder Well** is the musical project of Los Angeles–based songwriter, composer, and multi-instrumentalist Amelia Baker. Cinder Well extracts dark, rich and tender compositions which nod to, but also stray from traditional musical languages.

event.description:
Nothing else sounds like **Drag Talk**. On debut album Drink The Ocean (MNRK Heavy), the L.A. band finds gauzy beauty in the fathomless chaos that surrounds us, their exquisite shoegaze guitars and Britpop melodicism skewed with Jutty Taylor’s genre-fluid vocals.

Harnessing ‘90s indie nostalgia to here-and-now emotional responses, Drag Talk’s lush atmospherics, spacious beats, and hugely emotive hooks create something singular yet accessible and authentic. “I feel like we’re hardcore punk dudes who love Oasis,” offered guitarist Ross O’Carroll, whose pandemic home demos were the germ of the band in 2021.

Drag Talk is a coming-together of like-minded friends with long, intertwined histories. O’Carroll, Taylor, and drummer Hayden Scott were former bandmates, while the latter pair also played together in Grammy-winning Swedish rock band Ghost. ***Sunday Skate Club: Dominican Day ft. Charlie Chimi (skate all night)SSC - house, disco, soul, funk***

***A love letter to Sunday Skate Club 🫶***

***Every Sunday from 8–12am, the rink becomes more than a skate session. It’s a weekly ritual where local club kids, industry folks, and NYC’s DJs get their flowers — and skate heads and music heads move in the same orbit.***

***Here you see the true versatility of a DJ. That epic artist you loved at 5am now accepts the challenge of an all-skate set around a groovy 100bpm — R&B, disco, and other unexpected jams. It’s a rare chance to hear their non-unz unz selections like R&B, disco, you name it. From thudding foggy sweaty beats the morning before (well, it may have still been your ‘night’) to idyllic skating in a psychedelic rink with jams that make you smile big. You start with a few laps, feeling out the floor, the room fills, the rhythm builds, and before long, you’re moving without thinking — just you, the music, and the night.***

***Then you notice friends slipping into the bathrooms… only it’s Club Flush, pulling the off-wheels crowd into something sweatier, louder, a little unhinged. Red-lit and hazy, fog stretching the room so it feels bigger than it is. An 18” sub shakes the floor, a hidden 21” built straight into the booth hits your chest. There are no grimy stalls, no smells (thanks all!) just a fully enclosed, immersive room. A few minutes in, and you forget you’re even standing in a bathroom. You might walk in for a second and stay for half a set. You might discover your new favorite DJ. You might skate, then dance, then skate again. That’s the point.***

***Every week is a different crew, a different sound, a different pocket of the city’s underground stepping forward. Sunday Skate Club is about unified movement — wheels, feet, bass, community. When these scenes overlap, the energy multiplies, and the night becomes something bigger than the sum of its parts.***

Torren Foot is a dj & record producer raised on the working docks of Melbourne’s inner west and is currently one of Australia’s most in demand touring artists.

Renowned for his distinct palette of house music and a street-forward aesthetic, Torren has seen consistent support from industry titans like Charli XCX, Seth Troxler, Jamie Jones, Calvin Harris, Dom Dolla, Honey Dijon, Boys Noize and John Summit.

His discography includes originals; More Life (2019), New Bottega featuring Azealia Banks (2023), Candy (2023), Sleep When I’m Dead (2024) & Feed The Streets (2024). Torren Foot experienced a global break out moment with his single New Bottega with Azealia Banks, amassing 30+ million streams and over 130,000 sound uses on TikTok, with notable support online from Chappell Roan, the track was featured in Pitchfork’s list of the 100 best songs of the year.

event.description:
End the summer on The Roof at Superior Ingredients with South African house favorite Kyle Watson on Sunday, September 27.

Known for releases on Dirtybird, Higher Ground, Ultra, Atlantic, and REALM, Kyle Watson has spent more than a decade building a name through bass heavy house records and late night club cuts that continue to land across dance floors worldwide.

Born in Johannesburg, Watson began producing music early on after studying piano as a kid and released his first record in 2007. In 2017, he earned nominations for Best Producer and Best Male DJ at the Dance Music Awards South Africa, helping solidify his rise within the international scene.

In 2018, he released his debut album Into The Morning, a project that expanded beyond his club catalog and introduced a broader side of his sound. Since then, he has toured across North America, Australia, New Zealand, Brazil, and South Africa with performances at Electric Forest, CRSSD, Shambhala, Ultra South Africa, and Dirtybird Campout.

Watson is also the co founder of Box of Cats, the label he launched alongside Wongo in 2016, which has become a home for forward thinking house music and emerging producers alike.

Join us in Williamsburg for a special Sunday rooftop session as Kyle Watson closes out the season at Superior Ingredients.

event.description:
First appearing in the mid-1980s as a derivative form of ghetto house, footwork has since evolved into a faster, markedly more frenetic style of battle-forward dance music than its predecessor. Shaped by the legacies of legendary dance group House-O-Matics, battle crew U-PHI-U, and pioneering producers RP Boo, Traxman, and DJs Slugo and Rashad, footwork’s rising star exploded internationally in the 2010s, with fans honoring the culture’s heritage and history across the globe.

In 2025, decades after originating on the South and West sides of Chicago, Cook County formally declared August Footwork Appreciation Month (F.A.M.) in recognition of the art form’s extraordinary impact and cultural legacy.

A year later, on the heels of his latest Moveltraxx single release (“House It Up” with DJ Phil), NYC welcomes Chicago’s very own Heavee in honor of F.A.M. With releases dating back to 2009, the Teklife-affiliated dancer-turned-producer is a pillar of contemporary footwork culture. Influenced by his late mentor DJ Rashad, the vast possibilities of digital worlds, and his own personal commitment to the art form, Heavee’s boundary-pushing work continues to broaden the scope of what footwork looks, sounds, and feels like.

The headlining DJ is supported by Chelsea, Petal, Rhino Clark, and BEYBLADE SHAWTY, four local sound artists/footwork enthusiasts whose work traverses the boundless expanse of Black electronic dance music.

Complementing an already dizzying catalogue of solo releases, collaborations, and production/writing/instrumentation credits, *Fantastic Thoughts* is Nate Mercereau’s clarion call. The sound of a thousand dams breaking simultaneously. A hootin’ and hollering tantric affair that dares the listener, “What if you did? What if you sang out with a resounding, heart-forward, ‘YES!’” — sang it with your whole chest? If the beat poets abided by the maxim “first thought, best thought,” *Fantastic Thoughts* stakes a claim on the plain of imaginary where every thought is best \[yes, fantastic, even\]. The resultant record is, without fail, maximalist — overflowing with ideas, varied influence, hairpin turns, and recursive processes — but it is also wildly \[one might even say transgressively\] sincere, and not infrequently vulnerable. From the first proggy breakdown of “There’s Something Here ...” \[in many ways the album’s thesis statement\] to the whispered mantra of “Resonant Angle, Seer Within,” we are borne atop a ceaselessly cresting wave of raw power and giddy delight. Mercereau’s is a singular vision, and yet, to anyone who has doggedly pursued the music, these sounds, these choices, will be instantly familiar.

Since the '90s, his timeless productions and euphoric sets have reached spiritual heights. London's Shy One reinvents the genre with a fresh take on mercurial, jazzy and jacking house. This year's "Mali" is a landmark release from one of the most exciting new voices.

For the night, we're blessed with another set from Chaos. Giving the people another set of their feel-good melodies. The same can be said for Robert Hood, the originating force behind Floorplan. This Detroit techno innovator has a near-peerless discography dating back to 1991. The Floorplan project now includes his daughter Lyric Hood, and as a duo they've brought a fresh life to his gospel-house masterclasses. DJ Ray and Miami's Extra Andrew wrap it up with a special sun-kissed b2b. More to be announced.

Sanjana Asha is a singer-songwriter from Atlanta, GA. Although classically trained, she was charmed at an early age by the likes of Norah Jones, Cornershop, and Queen. Her music draws from glimpses of memory, her Indian heritage, and the sounds she grew up with. In this way, it feels nostalgic, ethereal, and intimate. Sanjana’s debut EP, Metamorphosis, reflects the journey of trusting and making sense of one’s inner voice. She has released several singles since and created the Brooklyn-based band Miss Fish with guitarist and co-writer Max Cover. The project combines her soulful vocals with a metal guitarist, funk drummer, and rock bassist, creating a sound that spans the spectrum, not unlike The Velvet Underground, Slowdive, Funkadelic, Dinosaur Jr., and Sleep. Loud and quiet, abrasive yet beautiful, catchy yet angular, Miss Fish dives into an enigmatic ocean of feelings, revealing astonishing creatures fathoms below the surface, waiting to be discovered.

event.description:
On Saturday, September 5th, legendary DJ and producer Tommie Sunshine takes over Dead Letter No. 9 alongside Amber Valentine and SPRFRK.

A Midwest rave legend and longtime Brooklyn resident, Tommie has spent decades connecting house, electro, techno, and rock. His extensive career includes collaborations with Felix Da Housecat, James Murphy, Arthur Baker, DJ Hell, and Mylo, plus remixes for Yeah Yeah Yeahs, The Killers, Elvis Presley, Ladytron, and Avril Lavigne. Known for unpredictable, genre-blurring sets, he’s played everywhere from underground clubs and international festivals to the Guggenheim and events for Versace, Chanel, Raf Simons, and Jeremy Scott. Catch him in CARGO from 12:30AM–3:30AM.

Opening CARGO is Amber Valentine, whose joyful, electric sets draw from disco, house, and queer club culture. She co-produces PAT with JD Samson and runs Misster at The Woods, one of NYC’s longest-running weekly dance parties.

Holding down the Foyer from 9PM–3AM is SPRFRK, a Miami-born staple of New York’s queer underground known for a flamboyant mix of house, club anthems, and percussion. A resident of Scandalo NYC and one-half of KNDYFRK, he turns every set into a celebration of community and self-expression.

Venue opens at 5PM | Happy Hour 5–7PM | Music at 9PM

Kitchen open late

event.description:
Matroda takes over Knockdown Center for an extended 3PM to 5AM journey, moving from the open-air Ruins into the Main Hall as the night unfolds. He is joined by Richy Ahmed, Yaya, Nacho Scoppa, Mary Jane, Ammo Avenue, AAT, Mellizos, and LUMI, bringing together a lineup that spans established names and rising international talent across the global house spectrum.

Matroda leads with his signature “matrodasound,” blending house, bass, and tech influences, with releases on Insomniac Records, Repopulate Mars, Mad Decent, and UKF, alongside appearances at EDC Las Vegas, Ultra Europe, and Brooklyn Mirage. UK favourite Richy Ahmed adds decades of dancefloor experience shaped through clubs like DC10 Ibiza and Panorama Bar, while Yaya, founder of Tamango Records, brings a groove driven, percussive approach rooted between Berlin and Lisbon.

Argentinian talent Nacho Scoppa continues his international rise with releases on elrow Music, Kaluki, and Deeperfect, while Miami’s Mary Jane represents the US underground with releases on Maccabi House and Higher Ground. Ammo Avenue delivers high energy club records supported by leading figures like Jamie Jones and Marco Carola.

From the Netherlands, AAT brings her fast rising momentum with appearances at Awakenings, Loveland, Audio Obscura, and an elrow residency. Mellizos add a stripped back, percussive edge as a Texas based twin duo, while LUMI opens the night, setting the tone as the event moves from sunset through to late night.

event.description:
Born in North West London, Natanya has long considered music her second language. She began classical piano lessons at age four, quickly discovering her perfect pitch, and later honed her craft at the Julian Joseph Jazz Academy, where she began writing her own songs. Inspired by artists like Janet Jackson, Amy Winehouse, Paramore, and Stevie Wonder, she started producing beats with friends—laying the groundwork for her debut tape Sorrow at Sunrise (2023), a coming-of-age project told through six diary-like entries during her first year studying English Literature at University College London. She later expanded her sonic and emotional palette with her twin EP releases, Feline’s Return and Feline’s Return Act II, marking a bold evolution toward a more refined, pop-driven sound. With a rapidly growing global fan base and a fearless approach to experimentation, Natanya is poised to define her own lane.

What Does Your Ticket to the Haus on Hudson Cruise 2026 Boat Party Include?

Iconic NYC Views – Cruise past the city’s most famous sights like the Statue of Liberty, Freedom Tower, Ellis Island, and Brooklyn Bridge with front-row views.

Our Doubleheader Series returns on October 2nd at the Room of Superior Ingredients with two of Europe’s most talked about names in contemporary rave culture: ALT8 and Pawlowski.

Irish DJ and producer ALT8, also known as “The Irish Boy,” draws from early 2000s dance culture, combining trance, techno, offbeat basslines, and movement focused production. A resident at Germany’s renowned Gotec club, he reached an international audience through his breakout collaboration with Sara Landry, Heaven, followed by releases on respected labels including 44 Label Group and Doof.

He broke through with Future Legacy in 2019 before Demonic Dimension, released through the Possession project, became an underground anthem. His catalog has since grown with Final Outsider on KNTXT, Back with Another One alongside Fenrick, and La Temperatura with Byørn on Tomorrowland Music.

After eight years performing behind his iconic scarf, Pawlowski revealed his identity in 2025, opening a new chapter in his career.

On October 2nd, ALT8 and Pawlowski come together for a special Doubleheader Series edition built for the dancefloor from start to finish.

The duo—theOGM and Yeti Bones —co-mingle genres like chemicals, mixing gloriously hellish hip-hop, basement-born hardcore, future-facing punk, throat-slitting metal, jarring industrial, and off-kilter electronica into a concoction meant to combust the moment you press play or when they hit the stage. As such, the group has quietly haunted the darkest corners of the culture, peeking out with a series of unanimously acclaimed releases, A-list collaborations, and sold-out tours.

**N8NOFACE** has been described as a Chicano Flannery O’Connor playing chiptune Ministry, the Sleaford Mods of the American Southwest, Suicide for the 21st Century and Ghostmane meets darkwave, synthpunk dashed with Ween’s glue-huffing pop. Lyrically, his sometimes romantic, oftentimes violent storytelling tunes lean toward Narcocorrido, the bloody ballads of Mexican drug cartels. It sounds dark on the surface, but N8NOFACE’s music is a lot of fun, and as exciting and cathartic as the early days of punk and hiphop. 

**Slay Squad** are implementing the crew dynamic in the space of modern heavy music. Earning their stripes and cultivating a DIY ethos among Southern California’s discerning underground hardcore ranks, the sextet established their signature self-coined ‘ghetto metal’ in a way that is resonating with fans of swagger savvy hip-hop and no BS deathcore.

event.description: Tuscany-born but now based in Barcelona, **Marco** **Faraone** grew up with a DJ father and folk singing grandfather so was always bound to end up in music. After early forays into hip hop and drum & bass, it was techno that stole his love and soon saw him becoming a resident at Florence’s globally-renowned Tenax club. His regular sets saw him graduate from ‘crafty up-and-comer’ to one of modern techno’s most recognised and respected names with sets at Fabric, Panorama Bar, DC10 and many more of the world's most famous clubs. Marco Faraone had a sensational season at Amnesia in 2022. His blistering sets on the iconic Terrace and famous Main Room showed the diversity of his sound. As he lay down explosive sets across the house and techno spectrum, he proved why he is one of the hottest names in the game. Now he's unleashed the power of his much respected UNCAGE imprint and announced UNCAGE Events. Each one will find him playing the headline slot with a key label associate to make for fully immersive party experiences at the best clubs on the planet. His dexterity in the booth and ability to play big and powerful or more deep and nuanced left an indelible mark on all who heard him. His stylish productions make just as strong an impression: they have come thick and fast in the last few years with more than 40 original tracks, two full lengths and countless 12"s. Testament to the diversity of his sound is the range of different labels he has released on, from techno favourites like Rekids and Drumcode to the iconic house of Defected. His own UNCAGE is now at the heart of the underground thanks to a steady stream of music from the legendary likes of Radio Slave, Mark Broom and Donato Dozzy next to new school talents such as Flug, Anfisa Letyago and Marcal. His famously creative and relentless output continues at the end of 2022 with a track on Alan Fitzpatrick's We Are The Brave, a remix of The Advent on his own UNCAGE label and new music on Drumcode and Filth On Acid. The new year brings a remix for Eats Everything on EI8HT and a track for the Rekids 50th release anniversary compilation as well as much more besides. All this proves that Marco Faraone very much embodies the sound of contemporary techno.

Hosted by DJ and musician Steen, Open Decks is a creative and fun space where DJs can hang and share their house and techno music live. Hear your favorite or original tracks on Silo's front room sound system, a custom 15,000 watt Danley powerhouse.

If you want to play, talk to Steen to sign up. Sign-up is in person at the event only, slots are 12 minutes.

The first 3 DJ's play first-come-first-spin. Then we'll select names randomly from the sign-up list throughout the night. You'll get a half hour notice before your set time. This is to ensure that DJ's who can't make the initial sign up right at 8pm still get a chance to play.

Free with advance RSVP. Question? Hit up your host on IG @steenschmidt

The event lasts approximately 3 hours as we sail through New York City's iconic harbor.

Drawing on post-punk, new wave and synthpop to forge a unique electronic rock sound, Dream Prescription is one of those rare bands that can transform the challenges of life into artful recordings and still put on an electrifying show that feels like a party. Why doesn’t the real world live up to the world of dreams? How can we know what we want in the face of the bizarre distortions of modern society? Dream Prescription drives headlong into these questions with electronic music for the future.

NYC based indie pop/soul project Impossible Kings is the brainchild of the songwriting producer team of Brendon Hamilton and Terry Derkach.Their live shows have attained much acclaim, bringing their powerful vocal driven songs to life either with a full electric band or compelling acoustic performances.

Jersey City indie rock trio Manager is comprised of guitarist/vocalist Jon Chinn, bassist/vocalist Lori Cantu, and drummer John Dorcas. Built around reverb-laden guitars and bass-heavy grooves, the trio leans into space rather than filling it, letting Cantu's thick bass lines and Chinn's buzzing guitar work carry songs that land between hazy pop-rock and garage-inflected indie rock: hooky, immediate, and raw around the edges, producing songs that are economical in form but expansive in feel and built for the moment.

After a run of memorable shows, including appearances at London’s Barbican and Primavera Sound, Lambchop return to Europe and the UK for a new series of intimate performances.

Kurt will once again be joined by Minneapolis-based musician and producer Andrew Broder. During the past years, they’ve developed a live approach that feels loose, curious, and alive at the same time — songs can stretch, shift, and quietly transform from night to night.

The shows will take place in intimate venues across Europe and the UK, offering a rare chance to experience Lambchop up close. Kurt's unmistakable voice and songwriting remain at the centre, with Andrew’s inventive textures expanding the music into new territory.

Lambchop has never sounded quite like this before. In this stripped-back setting, they open the songs up and follow wherever they lead, letting space, electronics, and improvisation reshape familiar and also new material in unexpected ways.

This run of performances marks a new chapter in motion, subtle, exploratory, and unfolding in real time on stage.For longtime listeners and curious newcomers alike, this tour finds Lambchop still searching, still evolving, and still surprising.

Baby Blue Sound Collective returns to DROM for their 1st performance since 2011, benefitting the Congenital Cardiac Research Collaborative.  Founded in 2008, Baby Blue Sound Collective (BBSC) is an international musician-physician led ensemble that performs and records for pediatric cardiac charities. At DROM they will feature 16 musicians from USA, Australia, and Europe.  The lineup includes cardiologists, heart surgeons, intensive care specialists, nurses, and therapists. BBSC members are united by a love of music and a commitment to helping children with heart disease (and the organizations that support them). Over the years, BBSC has appeared in cities across the USA, as well as in Europe, Asia, Australia, and Africa.  The BBSC musical repertoire is super-eclectic, and includes jazz, R & B, pop, rock, funk, blues, and many original compositions. The 2026 Blues Alley show will feature 5 vocalists and a full horn section. BBSC is known as a high-energy performing group with the heart of a mission-driven community, playing music with purpose. This event promises to continue that theme!

Join us for an unforgettable evening as Baby Blue Sound Collective returns to DROM for a celebration of music, medicine, friendship, and hope - all in support of Research for Children with Heart Disease

**Craig Greenberg** has been hailed as NYC’s most acclaimed post-millennial piano man. Over the past 15+ years, the native New Yorker and multi-award-winning songwriter, has been a staple on the city’s music scene, capturing and building on the spirited ivory traditions of greats like Billy Joel, Ben Folds and Randy Newman with sparkling, soulful new musical twists, a larger than life personality and his insightful, dramatic sense of storytelling.

Craig has independently released 5 albums (his most recent EP, Between the Sea and the Sky, released in Dec 2022), with a new full length one slated for 2026. He has performed upwards of 1000 shows, since his start playing in bars while living in Chile, and later Spain, in the early 2000s. His songs have received praise in American Songwriter, the Huffington Post, Relix Magazine, and have been played on radio stations all around the country and internationally (as well as locally on WFUV). His latest music video for “Between the Sea and the Sky” has received multiple film festival awards, including winning “Best Music Video” in the Around International Film Festival (Barcelona) 2024. The single “Oh Caroline” off his 2020 full length release, “Phantom Life”, placed in the semifinals of the International Song Competition in 2021. He has performed everywhere from Lincoln Center in New York, to Israel and Cambodia, and with esteemed musicians such as Jackson Browne, Chris Barron (Spin Doctors), Jane Wiedlin (the Go Go’s), Louise Goffin, and Jerry Joseph.

Architects of sound design and voyagers of unexplored realities, the Brooklyn-based production duo **MEMBA** has steadily elevated their status over the past few years by crafting electronic music that is propped up by a rich tapestry of ancient world rhythms.

MEMBA charted globally with their song “For Aisha,” a tribute to Ishaan’s sister. The track’s inclusion in the Bollywood film “The Sky Is Pink,” which premiered at TIFF and is now available on Netflix, propelled its reach to a global audience, solidifying MEMBA’s ability to create music that strikes a deeply personal chord while resonating with a wide spectrum of listeners.

2018 saw the release of SAGA-I, an EP based around a particularly filthy planet in the MEMBA universe. The EP was transformed into a multisensory experience by coupling each track with relics from the planet that allowed the listener to taste, smell, feel, and see the music. The SAGA-I experience came to life at a sold-out warehouse event in Brooklyn. In 2019, MEMBA released SAGA-II on ODESZA’s label Foreign Family. The EP story was told through an audio-visual short film that showcased another planet in their universe.

The duo further expanded their catalog in 2021 with the launch of their PHASES project; a 4 EP offering that was released on every full moon between April – July, celebrating changes in state, in humans and all matter.

The past few years have seen MEMBA play EDC, Coachella, Bonnaroo, Electric Forest, Shambhala, Ultra, and Glastonbury, to name a few. They have supported ODESZA, Jai Wolf, Hermitude, and Clozee on tour, priming them for their own debut headline run in 2022.

Now, fresh off the heels of their self released UNI(\*)N EP in April 2023, MEMBA is looking ahead with a highly anticipated ‘The Inevitable End’ Tour. The tour will meld together their immersive stage production and high octane energy, transporting fans through a reality-bending live show.

Get ready to set sail on the ultimate party experience with Blue Booze Cruise 2026, hosted by HAUS ON HUDSON. This two-floor NYC party boat will be rocking with top DJ beats, flowing drinks, and unbeatable skyline views. Dance under the stars on the open-air rooftop deck or vibe out in the stylish indoor lounge. Whether you’re celebrating with friends or just living it up, this cruise delivers nonstop energy and unforgettable moments. Don’t miss your chance to be part of NYC’s most iconic boat party of the year!

What Does Your Ticket to the Haus on Hudson Cruise 2026 Boat Party Include?

Iconic NYC Views – Cruise past the city’s most famous sights like the Statue of Liberty, Freedom Tower, Ellis Island, and Brooklyn Bridge with front-row views.

Live DJs Across Two Levels – Move to the rhythm of Reggaeton, Hip-Hop, R&B, Afrobeats, Latin, House and more, spun by top DJs across two lively floors.

Indoor & Outdoor Vibes – Choose between open-air decks for fresh breezes or a climate-controlled cabin with panoramic harbor views.

Celebrate Life’s Big Moments – Ideal for birthdays, bachelorettes, anniversaries, or graduations. Feel free to bring balloons and cakes (note: outside food is not permitted). Check the ticket section for personalized event flyers.

Onboard Food & Drinks for Purchase – Treat yourself to expertly crafted cocktails and delicious bites from our menu. We have a different menu each week ranging from amazing hearty meat options to vegetarian friendly eats.

Professional Party Photos – Keep the memories alive with an event photographer capturing your best moments (details available in ticket add-ons).

Convenient Access & Parking Options – Free street parking near the dock or nearby garage options (around $40). We recommend using Uber or Lyft for ease.

Dress Code:

We embrace individual style while keeping a chic vibe. Please follow the guidelines below to ensure smooth entry:

DON’T: wear anything with offensive text, athletic shorts, swim trunks, slides, sweatpants, Timberlands, sandals, or flip flops.

DO: opt for trendy and put-together looks. Jeans (with minimal rips), smart casual outfits for men (think collared shirts, stylish tees, and jeans), clean sneakers or dress shoes, and forward-facing hats that complement your outfit are welcome.

How long will the party last?

The event lasts approximately 3 hours as we sail through New York City's iconic harbor.

Will I Get a Good View of the Statue of Liberty?

Yes! You’ll have a perfect photo opportunity with sweeping, 360-degree views of Lady Liberty and the NYC skyline right from the boat—so bring your camera and get ready to snap some unforgettable shots!

What is the location of the boat and when do we need to arrive by?

We have multiple boats going out all weekend with different themes. The location is Skyport Marina and all other information will be emailed to you.

After a run of memorable shows, including appearances at London’s Barbican and Primavera Sound, Lambchop return to Europe and the UK for a new series of intimate performances.

Kurt will once again be joined by Minneapolis-based musician and producer Andrew Broder. During the past years, they’ve developed a live approach that feels loose, curious, and alive at the same time — songs can stretch, shift, and quietly transform from night to night.

The shows will take place in intimate venues across Europe and the UK, offering a rare chance to experience Lambchop up close. Kurt's unmistakable voice and songwriting remain at the centre, with Andrew’s inventive textures expanding the music into new territory.

Lambchop has never sounded quite like this before. In this stripped-back setting, they open the songs up and follow wherever they lead, letting space, electronics, and improvisation reshape familiar and also new material in unexpected ways.

This run of performances marks a new chapter in motion, subtle, exploratory, and unfolding in real time on stage.For longtime listeners and curious newcomers alike, this tour finds Lambchop still searching, still evolving, and still surprising.

AITIS BAND

Formed by former Joan of Arc members Bobby Burg (Love of Everything) and Melina Ausikaitis, and joined by visual artist/musician Ray Borchers, AITIS BAND have carved out a singular space since their formation in 2019. They mix the theatrical with the absurd, fusing haunted house atmospherics with deadpan humor. Their lyric-driven songs literally report what “she said” — and how terrifying it was.

Their music channels club culture, teen melodrama, and tragic figures both real and imagined, veering from tender ballads to noisy anthems.

**AITIS BAND**’s setup is as unconventional as their sound: dueling Roland EG101 drum machines/keyboards and a MicroKorg. Ray controls three keyboards at once using weights for drones, while playing additional notes by hand and foot. Melina sings and plays a stringless guitar rigged with a contact mic and EarthQuaker Devices pedals. Bobby plays bass.

•

**Epoxy** is a New York City based trio founded by Alec Publicover, Cashel O’Malley, and Benjamin Leach. The band’s angular and melodic sound evokes that of 90s/00s post hardcore with an attitude rooted firmly in the present. This past fall, the group released their debut album “CIVILIANS!”.

•

Brooklyn alt rockers **CLONE** have just released their new 'Care To Try' EP, a blazing three-track offering, as well as fine limited edition 2-track '7” vinyl release. Together, this is their second major release via Portland label Little Cloud Records, featuring cover photography by famed artist Simon Larbalestier, well known for his work with Pixies and 4AD Records.

Since their earliest incarnation in Yonkers, NY as Rigor Mortis in 1986, the members of **Immolation** have blazed an uncompromising path from the nascent tape-trading underground through their current standing as one of the most beloved bands in death metal history.

Propelled by the dissonant harmonic acrobatics of guitarist Robert Vigna and the subterranean growl and slashing rhythms of bassist/vocalist Ross Dolan, Immolation’s core duo not only led death metal landmarks like Dawn of Possession but piloted the band through music industry pitfalls of dubious record contacts, sketchy agents and the mid-’90s commercial collapse of the subgenre they helped perfect—and never abandoned.

**Ancient Death** is a Massachusetts-based cosmic death metal band formed in 2019. Known for blending progressive and technical metal with lush atmospheric themes, the quartet released their highly acclaimed debut full-length album, Ego Dissolution, on April 18th, 2025 via Profound Lore Records.

**GIGI MASIN** is a multi-instrumentalist whose sound has evolved through landscapes of ambient, jazz, and electronic dance music. His work takes the listener into a realm of contemplation, a spellbound mind state where time and space appear to dissolve.

In 1986 Masin created *Wind*, an all-time ambient masterpiece. Self released and given away for free, Masin thought he’d made a jazz record; others called it ambient, but few really listened. He released *Les Nouvelles Musiques De Chambre Volume 2* in 1989 with **This Heat’s Charles Hayward**, which would go on to be sampled by **Björk** and **To Rococo Rot**, but at the time, it hardly registered. No matter. Masin had moved on, working as a postal manager, living with his wife and kids and making music at the edges of the day for theatre productions and poetry readings.

In 2014, Masin was approached out of the blue by Amsterdam-based label **Music From Memory** to release *Talk To The Sea*. It was a compilation of his music, including material from *Wind* and the handful of recordings from the intervening decades that displayed the breadth of his talents, from zither and trumpet to synthesizers and radio sampling. In 2014, with **Jonny Nash** and **Young Marco**, Masin formed **Gaussian Curve**, an ambient supergroup that received international acclaim.

*Movement*, released in 2026 on **Sacred Bones**, is his next act. The tracks here are dynamic, draped in ambient hues but propelled by the vitality inherent to all great dance music. He describes it as “music for moving the body” or rhythm music for the romantic soul, reintroducing Masin on his own terms.

event.description:
On Friday, October 2nd, Lost Miracle returns to New York for a special showcase at The Ruins at Knockdown Center in Brooklyn. Founded in 2019 by French artist Sébastien Léger, the label and event series is known for its emotionally driven, story-led melodic house and carefully curated dancefloor experiences.

Blending melodic house, organic grooves, and immersive production, Lost Miracle has built a distinct identity rooted in warmth, depth, and detail. Its catalog includes standout releases from artists such as Tim Green, Chicola, and Raw Main, shaping a refined, transportive sound.

With over three decades in electronic music, Léger is recognized for emotive melodies, intricate rhythms, and modular influences. His career spans Coachella, Tomorrowland, and his acclaimed Cercle performance at the Great Pyramids of Giza, alongside releases on influential labels and ongoing work with Lost Miracle.

Joining him is Roy Rosenfeld, a longtime collaborator closely tied to the Lost Miracle sound. Known for emotionally rich, groove-led productions on All Day I Dream, Lost & Found, Rumors, and Lost Miracle, he has earned support from Solomun, Dixon, and Black Coffee.

The series has traveled through Tulum, Ibiza, Mykonos, Amsterdam, and Bali, now landing in New York at The Ruins at Knockdown Center—an industrial venue known for its scale, atmosphere, and immersive production potential.

McDaniel - "a dynamo with a brass-plated voice" (LA Times) and Ariel Weissberger - a multi-instrumentalist and Board Certified Music Therapist, have a special musical partnership. Collectively they’ve played National Sawdust, The Apollo, BAM Café, Joe’s Pub, Barbes, WNYC’s Soundcheck, and Leicester Square Theatre (London). McDaniel's vocals convey an intimacy tailor-made for Weissberger's latin and jazz inspired harmonies and grooves.

Sir Richard Newton is a local NYC band started by Dan Gleason and Larkin Bogan. They met as actors on tour with Green Day’s American Idiot and began writing songs on guitar and dobro in the stairwells of the Gershwin Theatre when they worked together at Wicked Broadway. Over the years they have watched that sound grow into a six piece band, with the additions of Shannon Ford (drums), Andy Dow (bass), Alec Bart (keys), and Andy Buslovic (guitar).

For the feelers, the seekers, and the sonically curious, Lia Menaker blends soulful pop with moody elegance and emotional grit. Dubbed “noirtronica” by WXPN radio, she is known for her playful loops and her rich, emotive voice. event.description:
Join Charlotte Greve and Kaoru Watanabe to celebrate the release of their new albums, WATERBODIES (Greve) and The Arch (Watanabe), at Public Records. Released by New Amsterdam Records as part of their 2026 selections, these works will be performed live on October 14, 2026. WATERBODIES spans styles from jazz and ambient to classical, power ballads and ‘80s-inspired dance pop. Unbridled and unapologetic, the album is a deliberate rejection of stylistic cohesion, a defiant journey through Greve’s most cherished musical worlds, and her most personal work to date. On The Arch, Watanabe places the vibrant timbres of traditional Japanese instruments (shinobue and ryuteki flutes, taiko drums, narimono percussion instruments, and koto, a 13-string zither) in compositions and jazz improvisations.

German-born, Brooklyn-based saxophonist, composer and singer Charlotte Greve has been praised by The New York Times as “definitely her own artist,” and featured on two of the publication’s “best of” lists. Greve has drawn acclaim from Pitchfork, MOJO and The Wire for a sound that moves fluidly across jazz, classical and experimental traditions. A sought-after sidewoman for artists including Chris Morrissey, Laura Veirs, Cass McCombs and Matt Pavolka, she recently premiered Breathe for the award-winning vocal ensemble Lorelei, as well as Continuing, a saxophone-and-choir piece presented by Carnegie Hall that debuted at the Solomon R. Guggenheim Museum.

Composer and instrumentalist Kaoru Watanabe's work is rooted in traditional Japanese performing arts and infused with contemporary experimental and improvisational elements. He is a highly sought-after collaborator, working with such iconic artists as André 3000, Yo-Yo Ma, Wes Anderson, Mikhail Baryshnikov, Laurie Anderson, Jason Moran, Rhiannon Giddens, Silkroad Ensemble, and Japanese National Living Treasure Bando Tamasaburo. Watanabe is the founder of Bloodlines Interwoven, a multifaceted commissioning ensemble celebrating heritage, immigration, and diaspora through music.

\-

Alix Perez (Belgium/UK) and Eprom (USA) are **SHADES**.

Perez found his rise to fame in drum n bass, releasing on Shogun Audio, Exit Recordings amongst many other labels and collaborating with the foremost names in dance and electronic music such as Noisia, Foreign Beggars, dBridge, and many more.

Eprom gained his well-deserved success through his innovative take on bass music, a unique sound that has the likes of Gaslamp Killer, Kutmah, D-Styles singing his praises and supporting his music.

SHADES exemplifies slanted grooves, a deep pocket and hard yet graceful composition. The debut self-titled EP (released on Alpha Pup) is a truly unique body of work.

Aware of each other’s music for some time before meeting, Perez and Eprom first crossed paths at the 2013/2014 Northern Bass festival in New Zealand. The following summer they met again at the Red Bull Studios LA producing the Foreign Beggars’ Modus EP. This initial studio session led to further collaborations and SHADES was born.

XLR8R have rightly said “music that’s not only a legitimate full-frontal assault in the same vein as tunes from that golden era of gluttonous bass and synths, but that embraces that ethos while giving it a more polished feel”.

event.description:
Channel Tres headlines Knockdown Center alongside Eliza Rose on Sept 10.

The rules don’t apply to Channel Tres. He crosses dimensions not only as an artist, but also as a man. He’s the rare creative who is just as comfortable DJ-ing under the neon lights of an after-hours club as he is throwing down on a track next to our generation’s finest wordsmiths or getting bodies to move from the main stage of your favorite festival. The Compton native isn’t shy about painting his nails and tending to his dogs, yet he casts a shadowy presence that you’ll never quite put your finger on. You’ll get a glimpse of who he is in his lyrics though he never gives it all away. That’s why he’s quietly entrenched himself at the forefront of the culture as a conundrum. He introduced himself as a solo artist with the 2018 Channel Tres EP, boasting “Topdown” and “Controller.” 2020’s i can’t go outside EP sent him into overdrive accelerated by “fuego” \[feat. Tyler, The Creator\]. Beyond collaborations with KAYTRANADA, Kito, SG Lewis, and Charlotte Day Wilson, he joined forces with Jungle on “I’ve Been In Love,” gathering 135 million-plus Spotify streams. 2024 saw him deliver his debut, Head Rush. Billboard christened it “a sophisticated, swaggy amalgamation of hip-hop, R&B and electronic music that tracks his rise from his native Compton to big tours and big festival stages.” Between selling out headline shows, he shined at festivals a la Coachella, Bonnaroo, and HARD. Moving fluidly between electronic, R&B, hip-hop, and alternative, his second full-length LP, Enigma, equally embodies the nuances of his sonic preferences and his personality. In early 2025, he left his previous label, grabbed his MPC, rented an Airbnb in Topanga Canyon, and fashioned a foundation for Enigma. Shocking an incomparable vision to life, he collaborated with the likes of Nick Solomon, Jesse Saint John, Pharrell, Robyn, Polo & Pan, and Kungs. Across the record, he perfects his signature “Compton House” sound and stands out as the truest kind of enigma.

Born out of the late-’90s New Jersey hardcore underground, **The Dillinger Escape Plan** detonated onto the extreme music scene with a sound that felt less like a band and more like a structural collapse in real time. With the release of their landmark 1999 debut album Calculating Infinity, the group redefined the boundaries of hardcore, metal, and experimental music through impossible time signatures, violent precision, and a chaotic live presence that quickly became legendary.

The Dillinger Escape Plan fused mathcore complexity with grindcore intensity and punk unpredictability. The Calculating Infinity era became synonymous with total sensory overload. Their live shows were infamous for shattered equipment, stage-dives from impossible heights, and performances that blurred the line between catharsis and collapse. Yet beneath the chaos was a level of compositional sophistication that would influence an entire generation of progressive metal, hardcore, and experimental bands for decades to come.

More than just a debut record, Calculating Infinity remains a defining statement in heavy music — an album that challenged listeners, alienated purists, and established The Dillinger Escape Plan as one of the most fearless and innovative acts of their era.
