event.description:
An integral part of the early-'80s thrash metal movement that spawned acts like Metallica and Anthrax, New Jersey's **Overkill** garnered a reputation for brutal, pounding speed and technique. Emerging in 1985 with the punishing Feel the Fire, the band built up a strong following in the metal underground with subsequent outings like Under the Influence (1988) and Years of Decay (1989). Despite enduring myriad label and lineup changes -- bassist D. D. Verni and lead vocalist Bobby "Blitz" Ellsworth have been the group's sole constant members -- Overkill have remained one of the East Coast's most successful and versatile metal outfits, dabbling in doom, industrial, and stoner metal, while releasing an abundance of critically acclaimed albums like White Devil Armory (2014), The Wings of War (2019), and Scorched (2023).

**Tower**, the New York City outfit, channels a potent blend of straightforward hard rock and riff-heavy metal to ignite crowds through technical skill, swagger, and memorable melodies. Powerhouse vocalist Sarabeth Eve Linden leads the group, which also showcases guitarists James Danzo and Zak Penley along with bassist and backing vocalist Philippe Arman; formed in 2015, the band draws inspiration from Slade, Thin Lizzy, Judas Priest, and Scorpions. Shortly after its inception, Tower signed with the Manhattan independent label the End and issued its eagerly awaited self-titled debut album in 2016.

Riki Rose grew up in the vibrant Satmer Hasidic community of Williamsburg, New York. Her upbringing was steeped in tradition, where she first encountered the rich tapestry of Yiddish culture and music. Despite the community’s insular nature, Riki’s passion for music transcended boundaries, leading her to explore diverse musical landscapes. Her early experiences in Williamsburg laid the foundation for her unique artistic voice, one that resonates with authenticity and depth.

Her musical style is a tapestry woven from a myriad of influences. Her deep roots in Yiddish culture provide a rich lyrical foundation, while her exposure to contemporary sounds fuels her innovative compositions. Influenced by both traditional Chazzanut and modern genres, Riki’s work reflects a seamless blend of the old and the new. Her journey as an artist is marked by a commitment to authenticity and a fearless exploration of diverse musical expressions, making her a unique voice in the world of music.

Funk Tribu takes over Knockdown Center's Ruins and Main Hall for a day-into-night RUSH marathon, joined by Afem Syko, Innamorati, Supergloss, LOVEFOXY, Ksenyeah and x3butterfly.   

Colombian-born DJ Funk Tribu makes his RUSH debut on October 17. Known as a key architect of modern high-impact, groove-oriented trance, he leads the charge alongside an allstar cast.  

Outside, he’s joined by Berlin’s LOVEFOXY as well as two of NY's best: x3butterfly and Ksenyeah. LOVEFOXY balances riotous club energy with a raw and direct energy that can go head-to-head with the most potent warehouse sounds. x3butterfly and Ksenyeah are unmissable presences; each pushes their own unique visions that are as adventurous as they are slamming. At the center of it all, Funk Tribu delivers a set that’s specially-tooled for the open air stage.

Inside, darkness takes hold as the program turns towards the shadows. In addition to a second headlining set from Funk Tribu, Afem Syko, Innamorati and Supergloss step up. Syko is best known for his ruthless touch; his breakout "RAS1" on the R Label Group is one of the most twisted examples of large-scale techno to be unleashed in the last five years. X-IZE founder Supergloss captures a unique blend of throttling techno and euphoric trance. Innamorati is the new duo of j:drive and TRIPS. Proving to be greater than sum of their parts, Innamorati tunnels straight to the core.

event.description:
Sunday Skate Club ft. Love Games w/ Lauren Murada, Finn Jones, Party Dad, Club Flush: Andrew Lenox (skate all night)

A love letter to Sunday Skate Club 🫶

Every Sunday from 8–12am, the rink becomes more than a skate session. It’s a weekly ritual where local club kids, industry folks, and NYC’s DJs get their flowers — and skate heads and music heads move in the same orbit.

Here you see the true versatility of a DJ. That epic artist you loved at 5am now accepts the challenge of an all-skate set around a groovy 100bpm — R&B, disco, and other unexpected jams. It’s a rare chance to hear their non-unz unz selections like R&B, disco, you name it. From thudding foggy sweaty beats the morning before (well, it may have still been your ‘night’) to idyllic skating in a psychedelic rink with jams that make you smile big. You start with a few laps, feeling out the floor, the room fills, the rhythm builds, and before long, you’re moving without thinking — just you, the music, and the night.

Then you notice friends slipping into the bathrooms… only it’s Club Flush, pulling the off-wheels crowd into something sweatier, louder, a little unhinged. Red-lit and hazy, fog stretching the room so it feels bigger than it is. An 18” sub shakes the floor, a hidden 21” built straight into the booth hits your chest. There are no grimy stalls, no smells (thanks all!) just a fully enclosed, immersive room. A few minutes in, and you forget you’re even standing in a bathroom. You might walk in for a second and stay for half a set. You might discover your new favorite DJ. You might skate, then dance, then skate again. That’s the point.

Every week is a different crew, a different sound, a different pocket of the city’s underground stepping forward. Sunday Skate Club is about unified movement — wheels, feet, bass, community. When these scenes overlap, the energy multiplies, and the night becomes something bigger than the sum of its parts.

See you every Sunday at 8.

Vibe and skate to the music of 70s/80s Disco, Funk, R&B, and 90s/2000s Hip Hop

Cosmic Gate takes over Superior Ingredients Rooftop on Sunday, November 8, joined by Sinca, Derya Zor, sunrYse, and 4YÛ.

For more than 27 years, German artist Nic Chagall has built Cosmic Gate into one of trance’s most recognized names. His catalog includes genre classics “Fire Wire” and “Exploration of Space,” alongside fan favorites such as “am2pm,” “Fall Into You,” “Nothing To Hide,” and “Your Mind.”

GRAMMY-nominated and once named the highest climber in DJ Mag’s Top 100, Cosmic Gate has performed at Tomorrowland, EDC, Ultra, Creamfields, Dreamstate, Transmission, and A State of Trance. His remix catalog includes music from Armin van Buuren, Tiësto, deadmau5, Above & Beyond, and Gabriel & Dresden. He also runs Wake Your Mind Records and hosts the weekly WYM Radio show.

Joining him is Montréal DJ and producer Sinca, whose sets move between progressive house, classic house, minimal, and indie dance. Her music has appeared on Purified, Bedrock, Anjunadeep, All Day I Dream, and Days Like Nights, with performances at Coachella’s Do LaB, Burning Man, SXM Festival, Stereo Montréal, Brooklyn Mirage, and Akasha Ibiza.

Local artists Derya Zor, sunrYse, and 4YÛ complete the lineup for a Sunday above Brooklyn.

Steady Sun is the brainchild of Dylan Nowik, a songwriter and producer who has been quietly making his mark on the worldwide music scene. He has written for and served as the primary guitarist for Clairo’s most recent records; has performed on Jimmy Fallon with both Clairo and Black Thought on separate occasions; has written music covered by Angel Olsen, and has written for El Michels Affair, Norah Jones and Leon Bridges.

JOY marks the fourth album from the Catskill, NY-based psychedelic project, Steady Sun, who formed in 2011 in NYC. The record is a transformative and kaleidoscopic journey, birthed from many transcontinental trips taken from Nowik's Catskill, New York home to Los Angeles, the primary recording location and current home of producer Wayne Gordon, former head engineer of Brooklyn's storied Daptone Records.

The record explores: What if the notion of escapism was reinterpreted as the practice of arriving somewhere more idyllic? Could inner peace be ever-looming by one's side, like a benevolent phantom, waiting a lifetime to be acknowledged?

Gray Area presents Classmatic at H0L0 Yard on August 22, 2026.

Born in Tubarão, Brazil, Classmatic has become one of the standout names in tech house. His breakout release, "Toma Dale" on Jamie Jones' Hot Creations, became a staple from Ibiza to dance floors around the world, helping establish him as one of Brazil's leading exports in house music.

Since then, he's performed at iconic venues and festivals including DC10 Ibiza, Hï Ibiza, Space Miami, EDC Las Vegas, Warung Beach Club, and Club Vibe, while sharing lineups with The Martinez Brothers, Paco Osuna, Seth Troxler, Ben Sterling, and Beltran. His catalog includes releases on Hot Creations, Solid Grooves, Hottrax, Cuttin' Headz, Revival New York, Toolroom, and Deeperfect, with tracks like "El Primer Corazón," "Catuca," and his remix of Cloonee's "Sun Goes Down" becoming favorites among DJs worldwide.

Joining him is a stacked supporting lineup featuring ALVES, the Miami based DJ and producer whose growing catalog and club focused sound continue to turn heads across South Florida; Aly Meza, a rising name known for her dance floor driven selections and growing presence in Miami's house music scene; and Paradom, one of New York's emerging local talents with a reputation for keeping crowds locked in from start to finish.

Join us for an open air day into night session at H0L0 Yard featuring one of Brazil's most sought after artists alongside a carefully selected lineup of rising talent.

event.description:
Rising DJ and producer, Capochino has been brewing a genre-bending sound that has been tipping hats from industry veterans and landing him on the map as an artist to watch out for. From electrifying performances at iconic venues like The Marc, Kingdom Nightclub, Vulcan Gas Company, and The Venue, to sharing stages with respected artists such as Alleycvt, Hairitage, Saymyname, Kompany, Hermitude and Dirty Snatcha, Capochino’s ascent has been nothing short of meteoric. With the backing of influential figures like Mersiv, Levity, Dr. Fresch, and Zingara, multiple tracks getting played at EDC Las Vegas and Electric Forest, and making his festival debut at Home Bass in Florida, 2024 has proven to be a whirlwind year for this sonic storyteller.

Raised in Monterrey, Mexico and currently based in Austin, Texas, Capochino’s unique soundscapes draw influence from the two cities he calls home. From brooding mid-tempo tracks to bass-heavy anthems, Capochino fearlessly explores a spectrum of sounds and styles. He made a profound impact with his first track of the year, “Woke Symphony,” premiering on Headbang Society, followed by “Untethered Soul” featuring jean, released on Excision’s Subsidia Records. With each release, Capochino doesn’t just deliver music; he invites listeners to embrace their roots and tell their own stories through their unique creative expressions.
